newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 slides even faster but bargains seen.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 slides even faster but bargains seen.

text.p: The pace of decline in Czech shares gathered momentum on Tuesday with the PX50 index dropping 1.35 percent to 488.2 and the RPIX losing 16 points to 994.
The RPIX, which measures the performance of 10 relatively highly capitalised shares, fell below the 1,000 level, at which it was established on March 15, for the first time.
But despite the gloom on the bourse, some analysts said the sharp and sustained decline from the major issues provided the opportunity for some cheap buys.
Recent reports to investors on Komercni Banka and SPT Telecom from Patria Finance investment bank both recommended buying into the two companies. Ceska Sporitelna was recommended as a hold.

"Nine month results confirm our opinion that the recent price correction of all Czech blue chip stocks is not related to fundamentals of individual companies, but rather to structural problems of the Czech equity market," Patria said.
"Investors should take advantage of the current market weakness and increase their positions," it added.
On the bourse on Tuesday, Komercni Banka slipped 30 crowns to 2,000, SPT Telecom fell 50 crowns to 2,785 and Ceska Sporitelna fell 24 crowns to 299.
